title: Money day to day
focus: 收入 · 开销 · 省钱 · 浪费 · 划算 · 涨价 · 欠 · 预算
body:
# Money day to day

Everyday money talk: what comes in, what goes out, and whether something is worth it. These are the words for prices, debts and budgets that come up with friends and parents.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | shōurù | income | receive + come in → income |
| 开销 | kāixiāo | living expenses / spending (spoken) | pay out + melt away → spending |
| 省钱 | shěngqián | to save money (by spending less) | economize on money → spend less |
| 浪费 | làngfèi | to waste (money, time, food) | spend without restraint → waste |
| 划算 | huásuàn | worth it / good value | reckon it up, comes out ahead |
| 涨价 | zhǎngjià | to go up in price | water rising + price |
| 欠 | qiàn | to owe (money) | open mouth, lacking → owe |
| 预算 | yùsuàn | budget | calculate beforehand → budget |

## Which word?

**省钱 vs 存钱**: 省钱 is spending less (cooking at home). 存钱 is putting money aside in savings.

**收入 vs 工资**: 收入 is all your income; 工资 is just the salary.

## Sentences

- 菜又涨价了，难怪这个月开销这么大。 cài yòu zhǎngjià le, nánguài zhège yuè kāixiāo zhème dà: Vegetables went up again. No wonder we spent so much this month.
- 既然收入不稳定，开销就得按预算来。 jìrán shōurù bù wěndìng, kāixiāo jiù děi àn yùsuàn lái: Since our income isn't steady, spending has to stick to the budget.
- 健身卡从来不用，太浪费了，取消吧。 jiànshēnkǎ cónglái bú yòng, tài làngfèi le, qǔxiāo ba: I never use the gym card. What a waste. Let's cancel it.
- 说实话，在家做饭又省钱又健康。 shuō shíhuà, zài jiā zuòfàn yòu shěngqián yòu jiànkāng: Honestly, cooking at home saves money and is healthier.
- 机票涨价了，说不定等等更划算。 jīpiào zhǎngjià le, shuōbudìng děngdeng gèng huásuàn: Flights have gone up. Waiting a bit might be better value.
- 朋友欠钱不还，最影响感情。 péngyou qiàn qián bù huán, zuì yǐngxiǎng gǎnqíng: A friend owing you money and not paying it back hurts the friendship more than anything.
- 我还欠我妈两千块，这个月得省钱了。 wǒ hái qiàn wǒ mā liǎngqiān kuài, zhège yuè děi shěngqián le: I still owe my mum two thousand, so I need to save money this month.
- 这个项目已经超预算了，得跟领导汇报。 zhège xiàngmù yǐjīng chāo yùsuàn le, děi gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào: This project is already over budget. We have to report it to the boss.

cards.Example: 他的收入还算稳定。 tā de shōurù hái suàn wěndìng: His income is fairly stable
cards.Notes: 收 shōu receive, collect (收到, 收拾) + 入 rù enter (进入, 入口) = what is received and comes in, so income. Mirror: 支出 = expenditure. 收入 is all income; 工资 is salary only.

cards.Example: 在大城市生活开销很大。 zài dà chéngshì shēnghuó kāixiāo hěn dà: Living in a big city is expensive
cards.Notes: 开 kāi open; pay out (开支, 开工资 pay wages) + 销 xiāo melt away, spend; 金 metal: melt metal (销售) = money paid out and used up, so living expenses. Spoken counterpart of formal 支出.

cards.Example: 自己做饭能省不少钱。 zìjǐ zuòfàn néng shěng bù shǎo qián: Cooking for yourself saves a lot of money
cards.Notes: 省 shěng save, economize (节省, 省事; also shěng 'province', 广东省) + 钱 qián money = save money by spending less. 省钱 = spend less; 存钱 = put money aside.

cards.Example: 别浪费时间了。 bié làngfèi shíjiān le: Stop wasting time
cards.Notes: 浪 làng wave, 氵 water (海浪); also unrestrained (流浪) + 费 fèi spend, fee, 贝 money (学费, 免费) = spend without restraint, so waste money, time or food.

cards.Example: 这么买比较划算。 zhème mǎi bǐjiào huásuàn: It's better value to buy it this way
cards.Notes: 划 huá reckon, plan (related to 计划 jìhuà) + 算 suàn calculate (算账, 计算) = reckon it up and it comes out ahead, so good value. 不划算 = not worth it. 值 is similar: 值不值?

cards.Example: 最近什么都在涨价。 zuìjìn shénme dōu zài zhǎngjià: Everything's getting more expensive lately
cards.Notes: 涨 zhǎng rise, 氵 water: water rising (涨潮 tide comes in) + 价 jià price (价格, 价钱) = price rises, go up in price. Mirror: 降价 (降 fall). 涨工资 = get a raise.

cards.Example: 他还欠我两千块。 tā hái qiàn wǒ liǎngqiān kuài: He still owes me two thousand
cards.Notes: 欠 qiàn owe, lack: the character pictures a person with mouth open, yawning (打哈欠), later extended to 'lacking'. 欠钱 = owe money; 欠人情 = owe someone a favor.

cards.Example: 我们的预算只有五千块。 wǒmen de yùsuàn zhǐ yǒu wǔqiān kuài: Our budget is only five thousand
cards.Notes: 预 yù beforehand (天气预报, 预习) + 算 suàn calculate (算账, 计算) = calculate in advance, so a budget. 超预算 = over budget.

cards.English: Vegetables went up again. No wonder we spent so much this month.
cards.Hanzi: 菜又涨价了，难怪这个月开销这么大。
cards.Pinyin: cài yòu zhǎngjià le, nánguài zhège yuè kāixiāo zhème dà.
cards.Notes: 涨价 (L9) + 开销 (L9) + 难怪 (L7). 又 = again (already happened); 再 is for the future.

cards.English: Since our income isn't steady, spending has to stick to the budget.
cards.Hanzi: 既然收入不稳定，开销就得按预算来。
cards.Pinyin: jìrán shōurù bù wěndìng, kāixiāo jiù děi àn yùsuàn lái.
cards.Notes: 收入 (L9) + 开销 (L9) + 预算 (L9) + 既然 (L5). 按……来 = go by ..., follow ...

cards.English: I never use the gym card. What a waste. Let's cancel it.
cards.Hanzi: 健身卡从来不用，太浪费了，取消吧。
cards.Pinyin: jiànshēnkǎ cónglái bú yòng, tài làngfèi le, qǔxiāo ba.
cards.Notes: 浪费 (L9) + 取消 (L5). 从来不 = never (as a habit).

cards.English: Honestly, cooking at home saves money and is healthier.
cards.Hanzi: 说实话，在家做饭又省钱又健康。
cards.Pinyin: shuō shíhuà, zài jiā zuòfàn yòu shěngqián yòu jiànkāng.
cards.Notes: 省钱 (L9) + 说实话 (L1). 又……又…… = both ... and ...

cards.English: Flights have gone up. Waiting a bit might be better value.
cards.Hanzi: 机票涨价了，说不定等等更划算。
cards.Pinyin: jīpiào zhǎngjià le, shuōbudìng děngdeng gèng huásuàn.
cards.Notes: 涨价 (L9) + 划算 (L9) + 说不定 (L7). 等等 = wait a bit; 不划算 = not worth it.

cards.English: A friend owing you money and not paying it back hurts the friendship more than anything.
cards.Hanzi: 朋友欠钱不还，最影响感情。
cards.Pinyin: péngyou qiàn qián bù huán, zuì yǐngxiǎng gǎnqíng.
cards.Notes: 欠 (L9) + 影响 (L2). 还 here is huán, 'pay back', not hái.

cards.English: I still owe my mum two thousand, so I need to save money this month.
cards.Hanzi: 我还欠我妈两千块，这个月得省钱了。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ hái qiàn wǒ mā liǎngqiān kuài, zhège yuè děi shěngqián le.
cards.Notes: 欠 (L9) + 省钱 (L9). 得 děi = have to.

cards.English: This project is already over budget. We have to report it to the boss.
cards.Hanzi: 这个项目已经超预算了，得跟领导汇报。
cards.Pinyin: zhège xiàngmù yǐjīng chāo yùsuàn le, děi gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào.
cards.Notes: 预算 (L9) + 项目 (L6) + 领导 (L6) + 汇报 (L6). 超预算 = over budget.
